overrideRenames.basis: AbstractSelectionList.getScrollAmount is AbstractScrollArea.scrollAmount since 1.21.4 (the same field read)
AbstractSelectionList.setScrollAmount (clamped through setClampedScrollAmount) is AbstractScrollArea.setScrollAmount (clamped) since 1.21.4; vanilla sets the amount through it
AbstractSelectionList.clampScrollAmount is AbstractScrollArea.refreshScrollAmount since 1.21.4 (set the current amount again, clamped)
AbstractSelectionList.getMaxScroll is AbstractScrollArea.maxScrollAmount: max(0, maxPosition - (height - 4)) = max(0, contentHeight - height)
AbstractSelectionList.getScrollbarPosition is scrollBarX since 1.21.4 (rows' right + 8 both ways)
AbstractSelectionList.isValidMouseClick is AbstractWidget.isValidClickButton (button 0), which 1.21.4's list asks; the list's own isValidClickButton was unused in 1.21.3
AbstractScrollWidget.renderBorder(GuiGraphics, x, y, w, h) is AbstractTextAreaWidget.renderBorder
1.21.3 set every list scroll through setClampedScrollAmount (setScrollAmount called it); 1.21.4's setScrollAmount on a list hands the value to the override (CbGuiScrollListMixin)
getDefaultScrollbarPosition was getScrollbarPosition's default; 1.21.4's scrollBarX asks the override (CbGuiScrollListMixin)
1.21.3's mouseClicked offered a press hitting no entry to clickedHeader; 1.21.4 has no header clicks, the list's mouseClicked asks the override again (CbGuiScrollListMixin)
AbstractScrollWidget.mouseClicked took a press inside withinContentAreaPoint; 1.21.4 asks isMouseOver, so a widget overriding it gets 1.21.3's mouseClicked (CbGuiScrollTextAreaMixin)
AbstractWidget.mouseClicked asked clicked(x, y); 1.21.4 asks isMouseOver, so a widget overriding clicked is asked it there again (CbGuiScrollWidgetMixin)

overrideHooks.basis: AbstractSelectionList.getMaxPosition (rows * height + header) is contentHeight less 4 since 1.21.4; vanilla sizes the scroll range by contentHeight
AbstractSelectionList.updateScrollingState set the drag state; 1.21.4's updateScrolling sets it and answers it

classRenameBasis.net/minecraft/class_7528: 1.21.3's AbstractScrollWidget (class_7528) is 1.21.4's AbstractTextAreaWidget (class_10415, same members, same abstract getInnerHeight / scrollRate / renderContents); 1.21.4 reused class_7528 for the new AbstractScrollArea above it. Every 1.21.3 reference to class_7528 meant the text-area widget

net/minecraft/class_7543$class_7544$clas.basis: ChatSelectionScreen.ChatSelectionList.PaddingEntry is a static class since 1.21.4; 1.21.3 only handed the list on to Entry, which no longer takes it
